DormsConfig.description: Configuration for a dorm within the REX system.

color.description: A representative color, usually based on the primary color on their website.
color.title: Color

rename_from.description:
If a group with rename_from is found, it will be renamed 
to this group in the booklet and on the website.
rename_from.title: Rename From

contact.description: REX chair contact emails, available at https://groups.mit.edu/webmoira/list/dorms-rex
contact.title: Contact

rename_to.description: If the dorm is renamed, this is the new name to use in the booklet and on the website
rename_to.title: Rename To

groups.description: Subcommunities within the dorm, e.g. 'B3rd' in Burton Conner or 'La Casa' in New House
groups.title: Groups

include_on_cover.description: Whether to include the dorm on the cover of the booklet. Defaults to True.
include_on_cover.title: Include On Cover

EventSource.description: A source of event data: either a local CSV file or a link to fetch CSV data from.

file_name.description: Path to a local CSV file containing events, must be within the events/ directory.
file_name.title: File Name

link.description: URL to fetch event CSV data from, e.g. a published Google Sheets CSV export link.
link.title: Link

encoding.description: Encoding to use when reading the CSV data, defaults to 'utf-8'.
encoding.title: Encoding

OrientationConfig.description:
Configuration for orientation events. Set file_name or link to provide orientation
events (or leave both unset to disable orientation events entirely.)

file_name.description: Path to a local CSV file containing events, must be within the events/ directory.
file_name.title: File Name

link.description: URL to fetch event CSV data from, e.g. a published Google Sheets CSV export link.
link.title: Link

encoding.description: Encoding to use when reading the CSV data, defaults to 'utf-8'.
encoding.title: Encoding

mandatory_tag.description: Tag used to mark mandatory (blackout) events, used for validation and display.
mandatory_tag.title: Mandatory Tag

include_in_booklet.description: Whether to include orientation events in the booklet.
include_in_booklet.title: Include In Booklet

OrientationConfig.title: OrientationConfig

TagsConfig.description: Configuration for tags within the REX system.

color.description: Hex color code for the tag, used on the website
color.title: Color

emoji.description: Optional emoji to display next to the tag name in the booklet

rename_from.description: Tags that match rename_from will be renamed to this tag in the booklet and on the website
rename_from.title: Rename From

TagsConfig.title: TagsConfig

name.description: Name of the REX season, e.g. 'REX 2025'
name.title: Name

events.description:
Explicit list of event data sources (local files or links). If empty, every *.csv file
in the events/ directory (except the orientation source) is used automatically.
